    <script>
        function toggleLessonMenu() {
            const menu = document.getElementById('lessonMenu');
            if (menu) {
                menu.classList.toggle('active');
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            const menu = document.getElementById('lessonMenu');
            const badge = document.querySelector('.now-playing-pill');
            if (!menu || !badge) return;
            if (!menu.contains(event.target) && !badge.contains(event.target)) {
                menu.classList.remove('active');
            }
        });
    </script>
    <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='csrf-helper.js') }}"></script>
    <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='toast.js') }}"></script>
    <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='audit-tracker.js') }}"></script>
    <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='confirm-modal.js') }}"></script>
    <script>
        window.__GEN_SEED_TASK__ = {{ seed_task_payload | tojson if seed_task_payload else 'null' }};
    </script>
    <script>
        (function() {
            const deck = document.getElementById('genDeck');
            const empty = document.getElementById('genEmpty');
            const card = document.getElementById('genTaskCard');
            const body = document.getElementById('genTaskBody');
            const answer = document.getElementById('genAnswer');
            const title = document.getElementById('genTaskTitle');
            const badge = document.getElementById('genTaskBadge');
            const sourceLink = document.getElementById('genSourceLink');

            const startBtn = document.getElementById('genStartBtn');
            const stopBtn = document.getElementById('genStopBtn');
            const taskTypeSelect = document.getElementById('taskTypeSelect');
            const useSkipped = document.getElementById('useSkipped');

            const toggleAnswerBtn = document.getElementById('genToggleAnswerBtn');
            const acceptBtn = document.getElementById('genAcceptBtn');
            const skipBtn = document.getElementById('genSkipBtn');
            const blacklistBtn = document.getElementById('genBlacklistBtn');

            const blPanel = document.getElementById('genBlacklistPanel');
            const blReason = document.getElementById('genBlacklistReason');
            const blConfirm = document.getElementById('genBlacklistConfirmBtn');
            const blCancel = document.getElementById('genBlacklistCancelBtn');

            let currentTask = null;
            let isBusy = false;

            function getCtx() {
                return {
                    lesson_id: deck.dataset.lessonId || null,
                    assignment_type: deck.dataset.assignmentType || 'homework',
                    template_id: deck.dataset.templateId || null,
                };
            }

            function setButtonsEnabled(enabled) {
                toggleAnswerBtn.disabled = !enabled;
                acceptBtn.disabled = !enabled;
                skipBtn.disabled = !enabled;
                blacklistBtn.disabled = !enabled;
            }

            function setBusy(busy) {
                isBusy = busy;
                startBtn.disabled = busy;
                stopBtn.disabled = !currentTask ? true : busy ? true : false;
                setButtonsEnabled(!busy && !!currentTask);
            }

            function renderMath(container) {
                try {
                    if (window.renderMathInElement) {
                        window.renderMathInElement(container, {
                            delimiters: [
                                {left: "$$", right: "$$", display: true},
                                {left: "$", right: "$", display: false}
                            ]
                        });
                    }
                } catch (_) {}
            }

            function renderTask(task) {
                currentTask = task;
                blPanel.style.display = 'none';
                blReason.value = '';
                answer.classList.remove('is-visible');
                answer.textContent = '';

                if (!task) {
                    card.style.display = 'none';
                    empty.style.display = 'block';
                    stopBtn.disabled = true;
                    setButtonsEnabled(false);
                    return;
                }

                empty.style.display = 'none';
                card.style.display = 'block';

                title.textContent = `Задание ${task.task_number} · #${task.task_id}`;
                badge.title = task.site_task_id ? `site_task_id: ${task.site_task_id}` : '';

                body.innerHTML = task.content_html || '';
                renderMath(body);

                if (task.source_url) {
                    sourceLink.href = task.source_url;
                    sourceLink.style.display = 'inline-flex';
                } else {
                    sourceLink.href = '#';
                    sourceLink.style.display = 'none';
                }

                if (task.answer) {
                    toggleAnswerBtn.disabled = false;
                    answer.textContent = task.answer;
                } else {
                    toggleAnswerBtn.disabled = true;
                }

                stopBtn.disabled = false;
                setButtonsEnabled(true);
            }

            async function postJSON(url, payload) {
                const token = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.getAttribute('content') || '';
                const resp = await fetch(url, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-CSRFToken': token
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload || {})
                });
                const data = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));
                if (!resp.ok || !data || data.success === false) {
                    const err = (data && data.error) ? data.error : `HTTP ${resp.status}`;
                    throw new Error(err);
                }
                return data;
            }

            function animateSwap(nextTask, message) {
                card.classList.add('is-leaving');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    renderTask(nextTask);
                    card.classList.remove('is-leaving');
                    card.classList.add('is-entering');
                    setTimeout(() => card.classList.remove('is-entering'), 30);
                    if (message && window.toast) window.toast.success(message);
                }, 200);
            }

            async function startStream() {
                if (isBusy) return;
                setBusy(true);
                try {
                    const task_type = taskTypeSelect.value;
                    const ctx = getCtx();
                    const data = await postJSON('/kege-generator/stream/start', {
                        task_type,
                        lesson_id: ctx.lesson_id,
                        assignment_type: ctx.assignment_type,
                        template_id: ctx.template_id,
                        use_skipped: !!useSkipped.checked
                    });
                    if (data.done) {
                        renderTask(null);
                        if (window.toast) window.toast.warning('Задания закончились. Попробуй включить пропущенные или сбросить историю.');
                    } else {
                        renderTask(data.task);
                        card.classList.remove('is-entering');
                        card.classList.add('is-entering');
                        setTimeout(() => card.classList.remove('is-entering'), 30);
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (window.toast) window.toast.error(e.message || 'Ошибка запуска генератора');
                } finally {
                    setBusy(false);
                }
            }

            async function act(action, extra) {
                if (isBusy || !currentTask) return;
                setBusy(true);
                try {
                    const ctx = getCtx();
                    const data = await postJSON('/kege-generator/stream/act', {
                        action,
                        task_id: currentTask.task_id,
                        task_type: currentTask.task_number,
                        lesson_id: ctx.lesson_id,
                        assignment_type: ctx.assignment_type,
                        template_id: ctx.template_id,
                        use_skipped: !!useSkipped.checked,
                        ...(extra || {})
                    });
                    if (data.done) {
                        animateSwap(null, data.message || 'Готово.');
                        if (window.toast) window.toast.info('Задания закончились.');
                    } else {
                        animateSwap(data.task, data.message);
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    if (window.toast) window.toast.error(e.message || 'Ошибка');
                } finally {
                    setBusy(false);
                }
            }

            startBtn?.addEventListener('click', startStream);
            stopBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
                currentTask = null;
                renderTask(null);
                if (window.toast) window.toast.info('Остановлено.');
            });

            toggleAnswerBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (!currentTask || !currentTask.answer) return;
                answer.classList.toggle('is-visible');
            });

            acceptBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => act('accept'));
            skipBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => act('skip'));

            blacklistBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (!currentTask) return;
                blPanel.style.display = 'block';
                blReason.focus();
            });
            blCancel?.addEventListener('click', () => {
                blPanel.style.display = 'none';
                blReason.value = '';
            });
            blConfirm?.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const reason = blReason.value || '';
                blPanel.style.display = 'none';
                blReason.value = '';
                act('blacklist', {reason});
            });

            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.target && (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA')) return;
                if (!currentTask) return;
                if (isBusy) return;
                if (e.code === 'Space') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    toggleAnswerBtn?.click();
                } else if (e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') {
                    acceptBtn?.click();
                } else if (e.key === 's' || e.key === 'S') {
                    skipBtn?.click();
                } else if (e.key === 'b' || e.key === 'B') {
                    blacklistBtn?.click();
                } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    stopBtn?.click();
                }
            });

            // Если пришли через "поиск по ID" — показываем seed task сразу, без запроса.
            if (window.__GEN_SEED_TASK__) {
                try {
                    renderTask(window.__GEN_SEED_TASK__);
                    card.classList.remove('is-entering');
                    card.classList.add('is-entering');
                    setTimeout(() => card.classList.remove('is-entering'), 30);
                } catch (_) {}
            }
        })();
    </script>
    <script>
        // Конвертируем flash-сообщения в toast-уведомления
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            {% with messages = get_flashed_messages(with_categories=true) %}
                {% if messages %}
                    {% for category, message in messages %}
                        {% if category == 'error' or category == 'danger' %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.error('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.error('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% elif category == 'warning' %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.warning('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.warning('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% elif category == 'info' %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.info('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.info('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% else %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.success('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.success('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% endif %}
                    {% endfor %}
                {% endif %}
            {% endwith %}
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // 1. Scroll Reveal Animation
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('active');
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.15 });

        document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

        // 2. Simple Particles
        const canvas = document.getElementById('hero-canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        let width, height;
        
        function resize() {
            width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
        resize();

        const particles = Array.from({length: 50}, () => ({
            x: Math.random() * width,
            y: Math.random() * height,
            size: Math.random() * 2,
            speedX: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
            speedY: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2
        }));

        function animate() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(143, 0, 255, 0.4)";
            
            particles.forEach(p => {
                p.x += p.speedX;
                p.y += p.speedY;
                if(p.x < 0) p.x = width;
                if(p.x > width) p.x = 0;
                if(p.y < 0) p.y = height;
                if(p.y > height) p.y = 0;
                
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            });
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }
        animate();
    </script>
</body>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { // Прячем блок ДЗ для вводного урока
            const typeSelect = document.getElementById('lesson_type');
            // Ищем секцию ДЗ по data-section="homework" - это должна быть только секция с домашним заданием
            const homeworkSection = document.querySelector('section[data-section="homework"]');
            const homeworkField = document.getElementById('homework');
            const homeworkStatusField = document.getElementById('homework_status');
            
            // Проверяем наличие элементов, но не блокируем выполнение, если секция ДЗ не найдена
            if (!typeSelect) return;
            if (!homeworkSection || !homeworkStatusField) {
                console.warn('Секция ДЗ не найдена, функционал скрытия ДЗ для вводного урока недоступен');
                return;
            }

            let lastAssignedStatus = homeworkStatusField.value !== 'not_assigned'
                ? homeworkStatusField.value
                : 'assigned_not_done';

            function syncHomeworkVisibility() {
                const isIntroductory = typeSelect.value === 'introductory';
                // Показываем/скрываем ТОЛЬКО секцию ДЗ, не трогая другие секции
                if (isIntroductory) {
                    homeworkSection.style.display = 'none';
                    // Очищаем поля ДЗ при выборе вводного урока
                    if (homeworkField) homeworkField.value = '';
                    if (homeworkStatusField.value !== 'not_assigned') {
                        lastAssignedStatus = homeworkStatusField.value;
                    }
                    homeworkStatusField.value = 'not_assigned';
                } else {
                    // Показываем секцию ДЗ при выборе другого типа урока
                    homeworkSection.style.display = '';
                    // Восстанавливаем предыдущий статус, если был 'not_assigned'
                    if (homeworkStatusField.value === 'not_assigned' && lastAssignedStatus !== 'not_assigned') {
                        homeworkStatusField.value = lastAssignedStatus;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Инициализируем при загрузке страницы
            syncHomeworkVisibility();
            // Отслеживаем изменения типа урока
            typeSelect.addEventListener('change', syncHomeworkVisibility);
        });
    </script>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            if (typeof renderMathInElement !== 'undefined') {

                    delimiters: [
                        {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
                        {left: '$', right: '$', display: false},

                    ],

                });

                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.error('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.error('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% elif category == 'warning' %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.warning('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.warning('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% elif category == 'info' %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.info('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.info('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% else %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.success('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.success('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% endif %}
                    {% endfor %}
                {% endif %}
            {% endwith %}
        });

        <script>
            async function deleteLesson(lessonId, studentId) {
                const ok = confirm('Удалить урок? Это действие нельзя отменить.');
                if (!ok) return;
                try {
                    const csrf = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]')?.content || '';
                    const resp = await fetch(`/schedule/api/lesson/${lessonId}/delete`, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                            'X-CSRFToken': csrf
                        },
                        body: JSON.stringify({})
                    });
                    const data = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));
                    if (!resp.ok || data.success === false) {
                        const msg = data.error || `HTTP ${resp.status}`;
                        if (window.toast) window.toast.error(msg);
                        else alert(msg);
                        return;
                    }
                    if (window.toast) window.toast.success('Урок удалён');
                    window.location.href = `/student/${studentId}`;
                } catch (e) {
                    const msg = e?.message || 'Ошибка удаления';
                    if (window.toast) window.toast.error(msg);
                    else alert(msg);
                }
            }
        </script>

    <!-- HIDDEN FORMS FOR JS -->
    {% for hw_task in homework_tasks %}
    <form id="delete-form-{{ hw_task.lesson_task_id }}" method="POST" action="{{ url_for('lessons.lesson_homework_delete_task', lesson_id=lesson.lesson_id, lesson_task_id=hw_task.lesson_task_id, assignment_type=assignment_type) }}" style="display: none;">
        {% if csrf_token %}<input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="{{ csrf_token() }}">{% endif %}
    </form>
    {% endfor %}

    <!-- SCRIPTS -->
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/easymde/dist/easymde.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dompurify/3.0.6/purify.min.js"></script>
    <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='ajax-utils.js') }}"></script>
    <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='toast.js') }}"></script>
    <script src="{{ url_for('static', filename='loading.js') }}"></script>

    <script>
        const LESSON_ID = {{ lesson.lesson_id }};
        const CSRF_TOKEN = "{{ csrf_token() if csrf_token else '' }}";
        const ASSIGNMENT_TYPE = "{{ assignment_type }}";
        const INITIAL_BLOCKS = {{ (content_blocks or [])|tojson }};
        
        // Tabs Logic (с сохранением выбранной вкладки)
        function switchTab(tabName) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
            
            document.querySelector(`.tab-btn[onclick="switchTab('${tabName}')"]`).classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById(`tab-${tabName}`).classList.add('active');

            try {
                localStorage.setItem(`lesson_${LESSON_ID}_active_tab`, tabName);
                history.replaceState(null, '', `#tab=${tabName}`);
            } catch (e) {}
            
            // Refresh editors if needed (codemirror sometimes needs refresh on visible)
            if (tabName === 'theory' && window.theoryEditor) window.theoryEditor.codemirror.refresh();
            if (tabName === 'notes' && window.notesEditor) window.notesEditor.codemirror.refresh();
        }

        // Initialize Editors
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // restore tab from hash/localStorage
            try {
                const hash = (location.hash || '').trim();
                const match = hash.match(/tab=([a-z_]+)/i);
                const fromHash = match ? match[1] : null;
                const fromStore = localStorage.getItem(`lesson_${LESSON_ID}_active_tab`);
                const tab = fromHash || fromStore;
                if (tab && document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`)) {
                    switchTab(tab);
                }
            } catch (e) {}

            // restore teacher filter
            try {
                const saved = localStorage.getItem(`lesson_${LESSON_ID}_teacher_filter`);
                if (saved && document.getElementById('teacherFilterSelect')) {
                    document.getElementById('teacherFilterSelect').value = saved;
                    applyTeacherFilter(saved);
                }
            } catch (e) {}

            {% if not is_student_view and not is_parent_view %}
            window.theoryEditor = new EasyMDE({
                element: document.getElementById('theory-editor'),
                spellChecker: false,
                autosave: { enabled: true, uniqueId: `lesson_${LESSON_ID}_theory` },
                toolbar: ["bold", "italic", "heading", "|", "quote", "unordered-list", "ordered-list", "|", "link", "image", "|", "preview", "side-by-side", "fullscreen"]
            });
            // init blocks editor
            window.__lessonBlocks = Array.isArray(INITIAL_BLOCKS) ? INITIAL_BLOCKS : [];
            renderBlocks();
            try {
                const modeSaved = localStorage.getItem(`lesson_${LESSON_ID}_theory_mode`);
                if (modeSaved === 'blocks') setTheoryMode('blocks');
                else setTheoryMode('markdown');
            } catch (e) { setTheoryMode('markdown'); }
            {% else %}
            // Render Markdown for students
            const contentDiv = document.getElementById('theory-content');
            if (contentDiv) {
                contentDiv.innerHTML = DOMPurify.sanitize(marked.parse(contentDiv.innerText));
            }
            {% endif %}

            // Notes Editor (for everyone authorized)
            window.notesEditor = new EasyMDE({
                element: document.getElementById('notes-editor'),
                spellChecker: false,
                autosave: { enabled: true, uniqueId: `lesson_${LESSON_ID}_notes` },
                 toolbar: ["bold", "italic", "heading", "|", "unordered-list", "|", "link", "preview"]
            });
        });

        // Save Functions
        async function saveContent() {
            if (!window.theoryEditor) return;
            const content = window.theoryEditor.value();
            
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/content/save`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ content })
                });
                if (res.ok) toast.success('Конспект сохранен');
                else toast.error('Ошибка сохранения');
            } catch (e) {
                console.error(e);
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        function setTheoryMode(mode) {
            const mdWrap = document.getElementById('theory-markdown-wrap');
            const blWrap = document.getElementById('theory-blocks-wrap');
            const mdBtn = document.getElementById('modeMarkdownBtn');
            const blBtn = document.getElementById('modeBlocksBtn');
            if (!mdWrap || !blWrap || !mdBtn || !blBtn) return;
            if (mode === 'blocks') {
                mdWrap.style.display = 'none';
                blWrap.style.display = 'block';
                mdBtn.classList.remove('accent');
                blBtn.classList.add('accent');
                try { localStorage.setItem(`lesson_${LESSON_ID}_theory_mode`, 'blocks'); } catch (e) {}
            } else {
                mdWrap.style.display = 'block';
                blWrap.style.display = 'none';
                blBtn.classList.remove('accent');
                mdBtn.classList.add('accent');
                try { localStorage.setItem(`lesson_${LESSON_ID}_theory_mode`, 'markdown'); } catch (e) {}
                try { if (window.theoryEditor) window.theoryEditor.codemirror.refresh(); } catch (e) {}
            }
        }

        function addBlock() {
            if (!Array.isArray(window.__lessonBlocks)) window.__lessonBlocks = [];
            window.__lessonBlocks.push({ type: 'paragraph', text: '' });
            renderBlocks();
        }

        function removeBlock(idx) {
            if (!Array.isArray(window.__lessonBlocks)) return;
            window.__lessonBlocks.splice(idx, 1);
            renderBlocks();
        }

        function moveBlock(idx, dir) {
            if (!Array.isArray(window.__lessonBlocks)) return;
            const next = idx + dir;
            if (next < 0 || next >= window.__lessonBlocks.length) return;
            const tmp = window.__lessonBlocks[idx];
            window.__lessonBlocks[idx] = window.__lessonBlocks[next];
            window.__lessonBlocks[next] = tmp;
            renderBlocks();
        }

        function updateBlock(idx, key, value) {
            if (!Array.isArray(window.__lessonBlocks)) return;
            const b = window.__lessonBlocks[idx];
            if (!b) return;
            b[key] = value;
        }

        function renderBlocks() {
            const host = document.getElementById('blocksList');
            if (!host) return;
            const blocks = Array.isArray(window.__lessonBlocks) ? window.__lessonBlocks : [];
            host.innerHTML = '';
            if (!blocks.length) {
                const empty = document.createElement('div');
                empty.className = 'glass-panel';
                empty.style.padding = '1rem';
                empty.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)';
                empty.innerText = 'Блоков пока нет. Нажми «Блок», чтобы добавить первый.';
                host.appendChild(empty);
                return;
            }
            blocks.forEach((b, idx) => {
                const wrap = document.createElement('div');
                wrap.className = 'glass-panel';
                wrap.style.padding = '1rem';
                wrap.style.border = '1px solid var(--stroke-1)';
                wrap.style.display = 'flex';
                wrap.style.flexDirection = 'column';
                wrap.style.gap = '0.75rem';

                const head = document.createElement('div');
                head.style.display = 'flex';
                head.style.justifyContent = 'space-between';
                head.style.alignItems = 'center';
                head.style.gap = '0.75rem';
                head.style.flexWrap = 'wrap';
                head.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="display:flex; gap: 0.6rem; align-items:center; flex-wrap: wrap;">
                        <span class="status-badge status-info" style="opacity:0.9;">Блок ${idx + 1}</span>
                        <select class="neo-select" style="min-width: 220px;">
                            <option value="paragraph">Текст (без Markdown)</option>
                            <option value="callout">Выделение (callout)</option>
                            <option value="image">Картинка</option>
                            <option value="divider">Разделитель</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content:flex-end;">
                        <button type="button" class="neo-button ghost sm"><i class="fas fa-arrow-up"></i></button>
                        <button type="button" class="neo-button ghost sm"><i class="fas fa-arrow-down"></i></button>
                        <button type="button" class="neo-button danger sm"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>
                    </div>
                `;
                const sel = head.querySelector('select');
                sel.value = (b && b.type) ? b.type : 'paragraph';
                sel.addEventListener('change', () => {
                    const t = sel.value;
                    if (t === 'paragraph') window.__lessonBlocks[idx] = { type: 'paragraph', text: '' };
                    if (t === 'callout') window.__lessonBlocks[idx] = { type: 'callout', tone: 'info', title: '', text: '' };
                    if (t === 'image') window.__lessonBlocks[idx] = { type: 'image', url: '', caption: '' };
                    if (t === 'divider') window.__lessonBlocks[idx] = { type: 'divider', style: 'line' };
                    renderBlocks();
                });
                const btnUp = head.querySelectorAll('button')[0];
                const btnDown = head.querySelectorAll('button')[1];
                const btnDel = head.querySelectorAll('button')[2];
                btnUp.addEventListener('click', () => moveBlock(idx, -1));
                btnDown.addEventListener('click', () => moveBlock(idx, +1));
                btnDel.addEventListener('click', () => removeBlock(idx));
                wrap.appendChild(head);

                const body = document.createElement('div');
                const type = (b && b.type) ? b.type : 'paragraph';
                if (type === 'paragraph') {
                    body.innerHTML = `
                        <label class="neo-label">Текст</label>
                        <textarea class="neo-textarea" rows="4" placeholder="Обычный текст, без Markdown.">${escapeHtml(b.text || '')}</textarea>
                    `;
                    body.querySelector('textarea').addEventListener('input', (e) => updateBlock(idx, 'text', e.target.value));
                } else if (type === 'callout') {
                    body.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr; gap: 0.75rem; align-items:start;" class="profile-grid-responsive">
                            <div>
                                <label class="neo-label">Тон</label>
                                <select class="neo-select">
                                    <option value="info">Инфо</option>
                                    <option value="success">Успех</option>
                                    <option value="warning">Внимание</option>
                                    <option value="danger">Ошибка</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label class="neo-label">Заголовок</label>
                                <input class="neo-input" placeholder="Напр.: Важно" value="${escapeHtml(b.title || '')}">
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="margin-top: 0.75rem;">
                            <label class="neo-label">Текст</label>
                            <textarea class="neo-textarea" rows="4" placeholder="Суть выделения...">${escapeHtml(b.text || '')}</textarea>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    const toneSel = body.querySelector('select');
                    toneSel.value = b.tone || 'info';
                    toneSel.addEventListener('change', (e) => updateBlock(idx, 'tone', e.target.value));
                    body.querySelector('input').addEventListener('input', (e) => updateBlock(idx, 'title', e.target.value));
                    body.querySelector('textarea').addEventListener('input', (e) => updateBlock(idx, 'text', e.target.value));
                } else if (type === 'image') {
                    body.innerHTML = `
                        <label class="neo-label">URL картинки</label>
                        <input class="neo-input" placeholder="https://..." value="${escapeHtml(b.url || '')}">
                        <div style="margin-top: 0.75rem;">
                            <label class="neo-label">Подпись (опционально)</label>
                            <input class="neo-input" placeholder="Короткая подпись" value="${escapeHtml(b.caption || '')}">
                        </div>
                        <div style="margin-top: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem;">Подсказка: можно вставлять ссылки на материалы из «Библиотеки».</div>
                    `;
                    const inputs = body.querySelectorAll('input');
                    inputs[0].addEventListener('input', (e) => updateBlock(idx, 'url', e.target.value));
                    inputs[1].addEventListener('input', (e) => updateBlock(idx, 'caption', e.target.value));
                } else if (type === 'divider') {
                    body.innerHTML = `
                        <label class="neo-label">Тип</label>
                        <select class="neo-select">
                            <option value="line">Линия</option>
                            <option value="space">Отступ</option>
                        </select>
                    `;
                    const sel2 = body.querySelector('select');
                    sel2.value = b.style || 'line';
                    sel2.addEventListener('change', (e) => updateBlock(idx, 'style', e.target.value));
                }
                wrap.appendChild(body);

                host.appendChild(wrap);
            });
        }

        async function saveBlocks() {
            try {
                const blocks = Array.isArray(window.__lessonBlocks) ? window.__lessonBlocks : [];
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/content-blocks/save`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ blocks })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data || !data.success) {
                    toast.error((data && data.error) ? data.error : 'Ошибка сохранения блоков');
                    return;
                }
                toast.success('Блоки сохранены');
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        async function saveLessonReviewSummary() {
            try {
                const percentEl = document.getElementById('lesson-review-percent');
                const notesEl = document.getElementById('lesson-review-notes');
                const statusEl = document.getElementById('lesson-review-status');
                const scoreEl = document.getElementById('lesson-review-score');
                const maxScoreEl = document.getElementById('lesson-review-max-score');
                const gradeTextEl = document.getElementById('lesson-review-grade-text');
                const weightEl = document.getElementById('lesson-review-weight');
                const percentRaw = percentEl ? String(percentEl.value || '').trim() : '';
                const percent = percentRaw === '' ? null : parseInt(percentRaw, 10);
                const notes = notesEl ? (notesEl.value || '') : '';
                const status = statusEl ? (statusEl.value || '') : '';
                const scoreRaw = scoreEl ? String(scoreEl.value || '').trim() : '';
                const maxScoreRaw = maxScoreEl ? String(maxScoreEl.value || '').trim() : '';
                const score = scoreRaw === '' ? null : parseInt(scoreRaw, 10);
                const max_score = maxScoreRaw === '' ? null : parseInt(maxScoreRaw, 10);
                const grade_text = gradeTextEl ? (gradeTextEl.value || '') : '';
                const weightRaw = weightEl ? String(weightEl.value || '').trim() : '';
                const weight = weightRaw === '' ? null : parseInt(weightRaw, 10);

                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/review-summary/${ASSIGNMENT_TYPE}`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ percent, notes, status, score, max_score, grade_text, weight })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data || !data.success) {
                    toast.error((data && data.error) ? data.error : 'Ошибка сохранения итога');
                    return;
                }
                toast.success('Итог по уроку сохранён');
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сохранения итога');
            }
        }

        function insertRubricTemplate(taskId) {
            const checks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(`.rubric-ck[data-task="${taskId}"]`));
            if (!checks.length) {
                toast.info('Чек‑лист недоступен для этой задачи');
                return;
            }
            const picked = checks.filter(c => c.checked).map(c => c.value);
            const header = 'Проверка (24–27):';
            const lines = (picked.length ? picked : ['(пункты не выбраны)']).map(x => `- ${x}`);
            const tpl = `${header}\n${lines.join('\n')}\n\nРекомендации:\n- `;
            const ta = document.getElementById(`teacher_comment_new_${taskId}`);
            if (!ta) return;
            if (ta.value && !ta.value.endsWith('\n')) ta.value += '\n';
            ta.value += tpl;
            ta.focus();
            toast.success('Шаблон вставлен в комментарий');
        }

        async function saveNotes() {
            if (!window.notesEditor) return;
            const notes = window.notesEditor.value();
            
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/student-notes/save`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ notes })
                });
                if (res.ok) toast.success('Заметки сохранены');
                else toast.error('Ошибка сохранения');
            } catch (e) {
                console.error(e);
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        // ===== Lesson Chat =====
        function escapeHtml(str) {
            return String(str || '')
              .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
              .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
              .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
              .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
              .replaceAll("'", '&#039;');
        }

        async function reloadLessonChat() {
            const host = document.getElementById('lessonChatList');
            if (!host) return;
            host.innerHTML = `<div style="color: var(--text-muted);">Загрузка…</div>`;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/messages`, { headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }});
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data || !data.success) {
                    host.innerHTML = `<div style="color: var(--danger);">Ошибка загрузки</div>`;
                    return;
                }
                const msgs = Array.isArray(data.messages) ? data.messages : [];
                if (!msgs.length) {
                    host.innerHTML = `<div style="color: var(--text-muted);">Сообщений пока нет.</div>`;
                    return;
                }
                host.innerHTML = '';
                msgs.forEach(m => {
                    const mine = (m.author_user_id === {{ current_user.id }});
                    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
                    wrap.style.border = '1px solid var(--stroke-1)';
                    wrap.style.background = mine ? 'rgba(0,255,213,0.06)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)';
                    wrap.style.borderRadius = 'var(--radius-lg)';
                    wrap.style.padding = '0.85rem 1rem';
                    wrap.style.alignSelf = mine ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start';
                    wrap.style.maxWidth = '820px';
                    wrap.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">
                            ${mine ? 'Вы' : 'Сообщение'} · ${escapeHtml(m.created_at || '')}
                        </div>
                        <div style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.55;">${escapeHtml(m.body || '')}</div>
                    `;
                    host.appendChild(wrap);
                });
            } catch (e) {
                host.innerHTML = `<div style="color: var(--danger);">Ошибка сети</div>`;
            }
        }

        async function sendLessonChatMessage() {
            const ta = document.getElementById('lessonChatText');
            const btn = document.getElementById('lessonChatSendBtn');
            const text = ta ? String(ta.value || '').trim() : '';
            if (!text) {
                toast.info('Пустое сообщение');
                return;
            }
            // Защита от "спама кликами": пока отправка не завершилась — блокируем повтор.
            if (window.__lessonChatSending) return;
            window.__lessonChatSending = true;
            if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/messages/send`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ body: text })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data || !data.success) {
                    toast.error((data && data.error) ? data.error : 'Ошибка отправки');
                    return;
                }
                if (ta) ta.value = '';
                toast.success('Отправлено');
                await reloadLessonChat();
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            } finally {
                window.__lessonChatSending = false;
                if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        // Подгружаем чат при первом входе в комнату
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            try { reloadLessonChat(); } catch (e) {}
        });

        // Helper for setting task status via AJAX (Teacher only)
        async function setTaskStatus(lessonId, taskId, status) {
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${lessonId}/task/${taskId}/set-status`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ status })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    toast.success('Статус обновлен');
                    applySubmissionCorrectUi(taskId, data.submission_correct);
                } else {
                    toast.error(data.error || 'Ошибка');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        // Material Upload
        async function uploadMaterial(input) {
            if (!input.files || !input.files[0]) return;
            const file = input.files[0];
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('file', file);
            if (CSRF_TOKEN) formData.append('csrf_token', CSRF_TOKEN);

            const loader = loading.show(input.parentElement, 'Загрузка...');
            
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/upload`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: formData,
                    headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN }
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    toast.success('Файл загружен');
                    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 500); // Simple reload to update list
                } else {
                    toast.error(data.error || 'Ошибка загрузки');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            } finally {
                loading.hide(loader);
                input.value = '';
            }
        }

        async function deleteMaterial(url, btn) {
            if (!confirm('Удалить этот файл?')) return;
            
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/material/delete`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ url })
                });
                if (res.ok) {
                    toast.success('Файл удален');
                    btn.closest('.material-card').remove();
                } else {
                    toast.error('Ошибка удаления');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        async function detachLibraryMaterial(linkId, btn) {
            if (!confirm('Открепить материал от урока?')) return;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/library/materials/detach`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ link_id: linkId })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data && data.success) {
                    toast.success('Материал откреплён');
                    const card = btn.closest('.material-card');
                    if (card) card.remove();
                } else {
                    toast.error((data && data.error) ? data.error : 'Ошибка');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        function openLibraryAttachModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('libraryAttachModal');
            if (!modal) return;
            modal.style.display = 'flex';
            setTimeout(() => {
                const inp = document.getElementById('libraryAttachSearch');
                if (inp) inp.focus();
            }, 50);
            loadLibraryAssets();
        }

        function closeLibraryAttachModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('libraryAttachModal');
            if (!modal) return;
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }

        async function loadLibraryAssets() {
            const list = document.getElementById('libraryAttachList');
            const q = (document.getElementById('libraryAttachSearch') || {}).value || '';
            if (!list) return;
            list.innerHTML = `<div style="color: var(--text-muted); padding: 0.75rem;">Загрузка…</div>`;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/library/materials/api?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`, { headers: { 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN } });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data || !data.success) {
                    list.innerHTML = `<div style="color: var(--danger); padding: 0.75rem;">Ошибка загрузки</div>`;
                    return;
                }
                const assets = data.assets || [];
                if (!assets.length) {
                    list.innerHTML = `<div class="glass-panel" style="padding: 1rem; text-align:center; color: var(--text-muted);">Ничего не найдено</div>`;
                    return;
                }
                list.innerHTML = '';
                for (const a of assets) {
                    const tags = (a.tags || []).slice(0, 6).map(t => `<span style="padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--stroke-1); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700;">${escapeHtml(String(t))}</span>`).join('');
                    const row = document.createElement('div');
                    row.className = 'glass-panel';
                    row.style.padding = '0.9rem';
                    row.style.display = 'flex';
                    row.style.justifyContent = 'space-between';
                    row.style.alignItems = 'center';
                    row.style.gap = '1rem';
                    row.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="min-width:0;">
                            <div style="font-weight:900; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">${escapeHtml(a.title || a.file_name || 'Материал')}</div>
                            <div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 0.25rem; display:flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items:center;">
                                <span><i class="far fa-file"></i> ${escapeHtml(a.file_name || '')}</span>
                                ${tags ? `<span style="display:flex; gap:0.35rem; flex-wrap:wrap;">${tags}</span>` : ''}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="display:flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content:flex-end;">
                            <a class="neo-button ghost sm" href="${a.file_url}" target="_blank"><i class="fas fa-arrow-up-right-from-square"></i></a>
                            <button class="neo-button outline sm" type="button">Прикрепить</button>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    const btn = row.querySelector('button');
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => attachLibraryAsset(a.asset_id));
                    list.appendChild(row);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                list.innerHTML = `<div style="color: var(--danger); padding: 0.75rem;">Ошибка сети</div>`;
            }
        }

        async function attachLibraryAsset(assetId) {
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/library/materials/${assetId}/attach`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ lesson_id: LESSON_ID })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data || !data.success) {
                    toast.error((data && data.error) ? data.error : 'Ошибка прикрепления');
                    return;
                }
                const mat = data.material;
                const linkId = data.link_id;
                toast.success('Материал прикреплён');
                addLibraryMaterialCard(mat, linkId);
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        function addLibraryMaterialCard(mat, linkId) {
            const grid = document.getElementById('materials-list');
            if (!grid) return;
            const card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'material-card';
            card.dataset.libraryLink = String(linkId);
            const ext = (mat && mat.type) ? String(mat.type).toLowerCase() : 'file';
            const icon = (['jpg','jpeg','png','gif','webp'].includes(ext)) ? '🖼️' : (ext === 'pdf' ? '📄' : '📎');
            card.innerHTML = `
                <div class="material-delete" onclick="detachLibraryMaterial(${linkId}, this)"><i class="fas fa-unlink"></i></div>
                <div class="material-icon">${icon}</div>
                <div class="material-name">${escapeHtml(mat.name || 'Материал')}</div>
                <div class="status-badge status-success" style="opacity: 0.9; margin-top: 0.25rem;">из библиотеки</div>
                <a href="${mat.url}" target="_blank" class="neo-button outline sm" download>Скачать</a>
            `;
            grid.appendChild(card);
        }

            return String(str)
                .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
                .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
                .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
                .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
                .replaceAll("'", '&#39;');
        }

        async function createLessonTemplate() {
            const titleEl = document.getElementById('tplTitle');
            const descEl = document.getElementById('tplDesc');
            const title = titleEl ? (titleEl.value || '').trim() : '';
            const description = descEl ? (descEl.value || '').trim() : '';
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/library/lesson-templates/from-lesson', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ lesson_id: LESSON_ID, title, description })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data || !data.success) {
                    toast.error((data && data.error) ? data.error : 'Ошибка сохранения шаблона');
                    return;
                }
                toast.success('Шаблон сохранён');
                closeCreateLessonTemplateModal();
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        async function saveTeacherFeedback(taskId) {
            const answerKeyEl = document.getElementById(`answer_key_${taskId}`);
            const statusEl = document.getElementById(`status_${taskId}`);
            const payload = {
                answer_key: answerKeyEl ? answerKeyEl.value : '',
                status: statusEl ? statusEl.value : 'pending',
                teacher_comment: ''
            };
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/task/${taskId}/teacher-feedback/save`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    toast.success('Проверка сохранена');
                    applyTeacherFeedbackUi(taskId, data);
                } else {
                    toast.error(data.error || 'Ошибка сохранения');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        async function markReturned(taskId) {
            const payload = {
                status: 'returned',
                teacher_comment: ''
            };
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/task/${taskId}/teacher-feedback/save`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    toast.success('Отправлено на доработку');
                    applyTeacherFeedbackUi(taskId, data);
                } else {
                    toast.error(data.error || 'Ошибка');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        async function markGraded(taskId) {
            const payload = { status: 'graded' };
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/task/${taskId}/teacher-feedback/save`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    toast.success('Отмечено как проверено');
                    applyTeacherFeedbackUi(taskId, data);
                } else {
                    toast.error(data.error || 'Ошибка');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        function statusToRu(status) {
            if (status === 'pending') return 'Не начато';
            if (status === 'submitted') return 'Сдано';
            if (status === 'graded') return 'Проверено';
            if (status === 'returned') return 'На доработку';
            return '—';
        }

        function applySubmissionCorrectUi(taskId, submissionCorrect) {
            const taskEl = document.getElementById(`task-${taskId}`);
            const navEl = document.getElementById(`tasknav-${taskId}`);
            if (taskEl) {
                taskEl.classList.remove('status-correct', 'status-incorrect', 'status-none');
                if (submissionCorrect === true) taskEl.classList.add('status-correct');
                else if (submissionCorrect === false) taskEl.classList.add('status-incorrect');
                else taskEl.classList.add('status-none');
            }
            if (navEl) {
                navEl.classList.remove('nav-correct', 'nav-incorrect');
                if (submissionCorrect === true) navEl.classList.add('nav-correct');
                else if (submissionCorrect === false) navEl.classList.add('nav-incorrect');
            }
        }

        function applyTeacherFeedbackUi(taskId, data) {
            const navEl = document.getElementById(`tasknav-${taskId}`);
            if (navEl) {
                navEl.classList.remove('nav-returned', 'nav-graded');
                if (data.status === 'returned') navEl.classList.add('nav-returned');
                if (data.status === 'graded') navEl.classList.add('nav-graded');
            }

            const statusSelect = document.getElementById(`status_${taskId}`);
            if (statusSelect && data.status) statusSelect.value = data.status;

            const answerKeyEl = document.getElementById(`answer_key_${taskId}`);
            if (answerKeyEl && typeof data.answer_key === 'string') answerKeyEl.value = data.answer_key;

            // teacher_comment больше не редактируем как single-field; история хранится отдельными комментариями

            // Обновляем блоки для ученика, если они есть в DOM (например, учитель тестирует под учеником)
            const studentStatusEl = document.getElementById(`student-status-${taskId}`);
            if (studentStatusEl && data.status) {
                studentStatusEl.textContent = statusToRu(data.status);
                studentStatusEl.classList.remove('status-info', 'status-success', 'status-warning');
                if (data.status === 'graded') studentStatusEl.classList.add('status-success');
                else if (data.status === 'returned') studentStatusEl.classList.add('status-warning');
                else studentStatusEl.classList.add('status-info');
            }
        }

        function onTeacherCommentSelect(taskId) {
            const sel = document.getElementById(`teacher-comments-select-${taskId}`);
            const body = document.getElementById(`teacher-comments-body-${taskId}`);
            if (!sel || !body) return;
            const opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
            body.textContent = opt ? (opt.getAttribute('data-body') || '') : '';
        }

        function onTeacherCommentSelectTeacher(taskId) {
            const sel = document.getElementById(`teacher-comments-select-teacher-${taskId}`);
            const body = document.getElementById(`teacher-comments-body-teacher-${taskId}`);
            if (!sel || !body) return;
            const opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
            body.textContent = opt ? (opt.getAttribute('data-body') || '') : '';
        }

        function formatUtcIsoToDevice(utcIso) {
            try {
                if (!utcIso) return '';
                // Если ISO без зоны — считаем, что это время в MSK и добавляем смещение +03:00
                const hasZone = utcIso.endsWith('Z') || /[+-]\d\d:\d\d$/.test(utcIso);
                const iso = hasZone ? utcIso : `${utcIso}+03:00`;
                const d = new Date(iso);
                if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return utcIso;
                const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
                return `${pad(d.getDate())}.${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}.${d.getFullYear()} ${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
            } catch (e) {
                return utcIso || '';
            }
        }

        function decorateCommentSelect(selectEl) {
            if (!selectEl) return;
            for (const opt of Array.from(selectEl.options)) {
                const raw = opt.getAttribute('data-created-utc') || opt.textContent || '';
                opt.textContent = formatUtcIsoToDevice(raw);
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Декорируем все select с комментариями под таймзону устройства
            document.querySelectorAll('select[id^="teacher-comments-select-"]').forEach(decorateCommentSelect);
            document.querySelectorAll('select[id^="teacher-comments-select-teacher-"]').forEach(decorateCommentSelect);
        });

        async function addTeacherComment(taskId) {
            const input = document.getElementById(`teacher_comment_new_${taskId}`);
            const text = input ? (input.value || '').trim() : '';
            if (!text) {
                toast.warning('Комментарий пустой');
                return;
            }
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/task/${taskId}/teacher-comment/add`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ body: text })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data.success) {
                    toast.error(data.error || 'Ошибка сохранения');
                    return;
                }
                toast.success('Комментарий добавлен');
                if (input) input.value = '';

                const teacherSelect = document.getElementById(`teacher-comments-select-teacher-${taskId}`);
                const teacherBody = document.getElementById(`teacher-comments-body-teacher-${taskId}`);
                if (teacherSelect && data.comment) {
                    const opt = document.createElement('option');
                    // В live-режиме показываем ISO (время будет корректно у ученика при его рендере)
                    const label = formatUtcIsoToDevice(data.comment.created_at || '');
                    opt.value = String(data.comment.comment_id);
                    opt.textContent = label;
                    opt.setAttribute('data-body', data.comment.body || '');
                    opt.setAttribute('data-created-utc', data.comment.created_at || '');
                    teacherSelect.appendChild(opt);
                    teacherSelect.value = opt.value;
                    if (teacherBody) teacherBody.textContent = data.comment.body || '';
                }
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        async function updateTeacherComment(commentId, taskId) {
            const sel = document.getElementById(`teacher-comments-select-teacher-${taskId}`);
            if (!sel) return;
            const opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
            if (!opt) return;
            const existingBody = opt.getAttribute('data-body') || '';
            const next = prompt('Редактировать комментарий:', existingBody);
            if (next === null) return;
            const body = String(next).trim();
            if (!body) {
                toast.warning('Комментарий пустой');
                return;
            }
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/teacher-comment/${commentId}/update`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ body })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data.success) {
                    toast.error(data.error || 'Ошибка');
                    return;
                }
                toast.success('Комментарий обновлён');
                opt.setAttribute('data-body', body);
                const bodyEl = document.getElementById(`teacher-comments-body-teacher-${taskId}`);
                if (bodyEl) bodyEl.textContent = body;
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        async function deleteTeacherComment(commentId, taskId) {
            if (!confirm('Удалить комментарий?')) return;
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/teacher-comment/${commentId}/delete`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({})
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data.success) {
                    toast.error(data.error || 'Ошибка');
                    return;
                }
                toast.success('Комментарий удалён');
                const sel = document.getElementById(`teacher-comments-select-teacher-${taskId}`);
                const bodyEl = document.getElementById(`teacher-comments-body-teacher-${taskId}`);
                if (sel) {
                    const idx = sel.selectedIndex;
                    sel.remove(idx);
                    const newOpt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex] || sel.options[sel.options.length - 1];
                    if (newOpt) {
                        if (bodyEl) bodyEl.textContent = newOpt.getAttribute('data-body') || '';
                    } else {
                        if (bodyEl) bodyEl.textContent = '';
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        function getSelectedTeacherTaskIds() {
            const ids = [];
            document.querySelectorAll('.teacher-task-select:checked').forEach(cb => {
                const id = parseInt(cb.getAttribute('data-task-id') || '0', 10);
                if (id) ids.push(id);
            });
            return ids;
        }

        function teacherSelectAllVisible(flag) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.task-card').forEach(card => {
                if (card.style.display === 'none') return;
                const cb = card.querySelector('.teacher-task-select');
                if (!cb) return;
                cb.checked = !!flag;
            });
        }

        function applyTeacherFilter(value) {
            const key = value || 'all';
            document.querySelectorAll('.task-card').forEach(card => {
                const st = (card.getAttribute('data-task-status') || 'pending').toLowerCase();
                if (key === 'all' || st === key) {
                    card.style.display = '';
                } else {
                    card.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(`lesson_${LESSON_ID}_teacher_filter`, key);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        async function bulkUpdateTaskStatus(status) {
            const taskIds = getSelectedTeacherTaskIds();
            if (!taskIds.length) {
                toast.warning('Выбери задания галочками');
                return;
            }
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`/lesson/${LESSON_ID}/tasks/bulk-update`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ task_ids: taskIds, status })
                });
                const data = await res.json();
                if (!data.success) {
                    toast.error(data.error || 'Ошибка');
                    return;
                }
                toast.success('Обновлено');
                (data.updated || []).forEach(u => {
                    const card = document.getElementById(`task-${u.lesson_task_id}`);
                    if (card) card.setAttribute('data-task-status', (u.status || 'pending').toLowerCase());
                    applyTeacherFeedbackUi(u.lesson_task_id, { status: u.status, submission_correct: u.submission_correct });
                });
            } catch (e) {
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            }
        }

        function startReviewMode() {
            // Режим проверки: показываем только "сдано" и прыгаем к первому
            const sel = document.getElementById('teacherFilterSelect');
            if (sel) sel.value = 'submitted';
            applyTeacherFilter('submitted');
            const first = document.querySelector('.task-card[data-task-status="submitted"]');
            if (first) first.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
            toast.info('Режим проверки: показаны только «Сдано»');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

                    <img src="{{ url_for('static', filename='icons/icons8-сохранить-100.png') }}" alt="Сохранить" class="ui-icon ui-icon--sm"> Сохранить и добавить в урок

    <script>
        async function saveTasks() {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.task-card-entry');
            if (cards.length === 0) {
                toast.warning('Добавьте хотя бы одно задание');
                return;
            }

            const tasks = [];
            let hasError = false;

            cards.forEach((card, index) => {
                const number = card.querySelector('.task-number-input').value;
                const content = card.querySelector('.task-content-input').value;
                const answer = card.querySelector('.task-answer-input').value;

                if (!content.trim()) {
                    card.querySelector('.task-content-input').style.borderColor = 'var(--danger-color)';
                    hasError = true;
                } else {
                    tasks.push({
                        number: parseInt(number),
                        content: content,
                        answer: answer
                    });
                }
            });

            if (hasError) {
                toast.error('Заполните текст всех заданий');
                return;
            }

            const loaderId = loading.show(document.body, 'Сохранение заданий...');
            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]');

            try {
                const response = await fetch(window.location.href, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken ? csrfToken.content : ''
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ tasks: tasks })
                });

                const data = await response.json();

                if (data.success) {
                    toast.success(`Успешно создано заданий: ${data.count}`);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.location.href = "{{ url_for('lessons.lesson_homework_view', lesson_id=lesson.lesson_id) }}";
                    }, 1000);
                } else {
                    toast.error(data.error || 'Ошибка при сохранении');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error(e);
                toast.error('Ошибка сети');
            } finally {
                loading.hide(loaderId);
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        // Конвертируем flash-сообщения в toast-уведомления
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            {% with messages = get_flashed_messages(with_categories=true) %}
                {% if messages %}
                    {% for category, message in messages %}
                        {% if category == 'error' or category == 'danger' %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.error('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.error('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% elif category == 'warning' %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.warning('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.warning('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% elif category == 'info' %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.info('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.info('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% else %}
                            if (typeof toast !== 'undefined' && toast) {
                                toast.success('{{ message|e }}');
                            } else if (window.toast) {
                                window.toast.success('{{ message|e }}');
                            }
                        {% endif %}
                    {% endfor %}
                {% endif %}
            {% endwith %}
        });
    </script>
